text: The forest on this property was cleared in 2021, but we don’t have evidence of active clearing today. Satellite data (up to 2025) confirms 81.3 hectares of tree-cover loss in 2021, primarily in planted pine forests. However, the tool doesn’t track real-time activity or distinguish between legal harvesting, natural causes, or illegal clearing. Without newer data, we can’t confirm whether clearing is ongoing now.
